The Chairperson, the Medical Officer of Health or the Public Health Inspector, or any other officer authorized
by the Chairman, shall have the authority at any reasonable time to provide for the exercise of the provisions of
this by-law, and the Licensee shall provide every reasonable support.
It is an offense to maintain premises without a permit under this by-law or to violate any of the provisions of
the  by-law  and  after  being  convicted  by  a  court  of  competent  jurisdiction  for  such  offense,  122  of  the

written notice by the Chairman, the Medical Officer of Health or the Public Health Inspector, with regard to the
violation, the offender shall continue to violate such violation by a court of competent jurisdiction. Every single

"Chairman" shall mean  the person holding the office of the Chairman of this PradeshiyaSabha at the moment or
